config:
[variables]
main_domain = "${domain}"
grafana_admin_user = "admin"
grafana_admin_password = "${password:32}"
container_name_prefix = "${APP_NAME}-grafana"
minio_root_user = "loki"
minio_root_password = "${password:32}"
loki_s3_bucket = "loki-logs"

[[config.domains]]
serviceName = "grafana"
port = 3000
host = "${main_domain}"

[config]
env = [
"CONTAINER_PREFIX=${container_name_prefix}",
"GRAFANA_VERSION=13.0.1",
"LOKI_VERSION=3.7.0",
"MINIO_VERSION=RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z",
"GRAFANA_ROOT_URL=http://${main_domain}",
"GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER=${grafana_admin_user}",
"GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${grafana_admin_password}",
"GRAFANA_LOG_LEVEL=info",
"GRAFANA_COOKIE_SECURE=false",
"GRAFANA_COOKIE_SAMESITE=lax",
"GRAFANA_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY=true",
"MINIO_ROOT_USER=${minio_root_user}",
"MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=${minio_root_password}",
"LOKI_LOG_LEVEL=info",
"LOKI_S3_BUCKET=${loki_s3_bucket}",
"LOKI_S3_ENDPOINT=http://minio:9000",
"LOKI_S3_REGION=us-east-1",
"LOKI_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${minio_root_user}",
"LOKI_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${minio_root_password}",
"LOKI_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=true",
"LOKI_S3_INSECURE=true",
"LOKI_RETENTION_PERIOD=720h",
"LOKI_INGESTION_RATE_MB=16",
"LOKI_INGESTION_BURST_SIZE_MB=32",
"LOKI_MAX_QUERY_SERIES=5000",
"LOKI_MAX_ENTRIES_LIMIT_PER_QUERY=5000",
"LOKI_QUERY_TIMEOUT=2m",
"LOKI_MAX_QUERY_LOOKBACK=720h",
"LOKI_REJECT_OLD_SAMPLES_MAX_AGE=168h",
"LOKI_CHUNK_IDLE_PERIOD=30m",
"LOKI_MAX_CHUNK_AGE=2h",
"LOKI_CHUNK_TARGET_SIZE=1572864",
"LOKI_TSDB_CACHE_TTL=24h",
"LOKI_COMPACTION_INTERVAL=10m",
"LOKI_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY=2h",
"LOKI_RETENTION_DELETE_WORKER_COUNT=50",
"GRAFANA_HEALTH_INTERVAL=30s",
"GRAFANA_HEALTH_TIMEOUT=5s",
"GRAFANA_HEALTH_RETRIES=5",
"GRAFANA_HEALTH_START_PERIOD=45s",
"GRAFANA_STOP_GRACE_PERIOD=30s",
"LOKI_HEALTH_INTERVAL=30s",
"LOKI_HEALTH_TIMEOUT=5s",
"LOKI_HEALTH_RETRIES=5",
"LOKI_HEALTH_START_PERIOD=45s",
"LOKI_STOP_GRACE_PERIOD=2m",
"MINIO_HEALTH_INTERVAL=30s",
"MINIO_HEALTH_TIMEOUT=10s",
"MINIO_HEALTH_RETRIES=5",
"MINIO_HEALTH_START_PERIOD=30s",
"MINIO_STOP_GRACE_PERIOD=30s",
"DOCKER_LOG_MAX_SIZE=10m",
"DOCKER_LOG_MAX_FILE=3",
]

[[config.mounts]]
filePath = "/config/loki/loki-config.yaml"
content = """auth_enabled: false

server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  grpc_listen_port: 9095
  log_level: "${LOKI_LOG_LEVEL}"
  http_server_read_timeout: 2m
  http_server_write_timeout: 2m

common:
  path_prefix: /loki
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory

analytics:
  reporting_enabled: false

ingester:
  wal:
    enabled: true
    dir: /loki/wal
  lifecycler:
    address: 127.0.0.1
    ring:
      kvstore:
        store: inmemory
      replication_factor: 1
    final_sleep: 0s
  chunk_idle_period: "${LOKI_CHUNK_IDLE_PERIOD}"
  max_chunk_age: "${LOKI_MAX_CHUNK_AGE}"
  chunk_target_size: ${LOKI_CHUNK_TARGET_SIZE}

schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: "2024-01-01"
      store: tsdb
      object_store: s3
      schema: v13
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h

storage_config:
  aws:
    bucketnames: "${LOKI_S3_BUCKET}"
    endpoint: "${LOKI_S3_ENDPOINT}"
    region: "${LOKI_S3_REGION}"
    access_key_id: "${LOKI_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}"
    secret_access_key: "${LOKI_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}"
    s3forcepathstyle: ${LOKI_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE}
    insecure: ${LOKI_S3_INSECURE}
  tsdb_shipper:
    active_index_directory: /loki/index
    cache_location: /loki/index_cache
    cache_ttl: "${LOKI_TSDB_CACHE_TTL}"

compactor:
  working_directory: /loki/compactor
  compaction_interval: "${LOKI_COMPACTION_INTERVAL}"
  retention_enabled: true
  retention_delete_delay: "${LOKI_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY}"
  retention_delete_worker_count: ${LOKI_RETENTION_DELETE_WORKER_COUNT}
  delete_request_store: s3

limits_config:
  allow_structured_metadata: true
  volume_enabled: true
  retention_period: "${LOKI_RETENTION_PERIOD}"
  ingestion_rate_mb: ${LOKI_INGESTION_RATE_MB}
  ingestion_burst_size_mb: ${LOKI_INGESTION_BURST_SIZE_MB}
  max_query_series: ${LOKI_MAX_QUERY_SERIES}
  max_entries_limit_per_query: ${LOKI_MAX_ENTRIES_LIMIT_PER_QUERY}
  query_timeout: "${LOKI_QUERY_TIMEOUT}"
  max_query_lookback: "${LOKI_MAX_QUERY_LOOKBACK}"
  reject_old_samples: true
  reject_old_samples_max_age: "${LOKI_REJECT_OLD_SAMPLES_MAX_AGE}"
  discover_service_name:
    - service_name
    - service
    - app
    - application
    - container
    - container_name
    - job

ruler:
  storage:
    type: local
    local:
      directory: /loki/rules
  rule_path: /loki/rules-temp
  alertmanager_url: ""

frontend:
  max_outstanding_per_tenant: 1024

query_range:
  align_queries_with_step: true

querier:
  max_concurrent: 8
"""

[[config.mounts]]
filePath = "/config/grafana/provisioning/datasources/loki.yaml"
content = """apiVersion: 1

deleteDatasources:
  - name: Loki
    orgId: 1

prune: true

datasources:
  - name: Loki
    uid: loki
    type: loki
    access: proxy
    orgId: 1
    url: http://loki:3100
    isDefault: true
    editable: false
    version: 1
    jsonData:
      maxLines: 1000
      timeout: 60
"""

[[config.mounts]]
filePath = "/config/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/dashboards.yaml"
content = """apiVersion: 1

providers:
  - name: Observability
    orgId: 1
    folder: Observability
    type: file
    disableDeletion: false
    updateIntervalSeconds: 30
    allowUiUpdates: false
    options:
      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
"""
